finding: ARM get_current_task uses scalar-result tagging; generic non-stack/ABI/relocation memory dispatch emits direct width-specific BPF loads. Tetragon request1 has task+2156 as scalar and fails direct u32 load at B instruction659. Existing x86 B separates untyped/kernel addresses from stack/context/packet/map classes and routes them through probe_read_kernel. This is an evidenced common mechanism difference, with future affected before/after stock and fault-path results required for a repair claim.
repair_scope: Common ARM B untyped/kernel-memory lowering across apps, preserving actual width, typed stack/map/ABI/packet access and existing nondeterministic read-fault/fallthrough semantics.
